51302748.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human 6His-tagged PPARgamma LBD expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) using FITC-NTKNHPMLMNLLKDNPAQD peptide by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Isothermal Titration Calorimetry: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry. A peptide derived from the TRAP220 co-activator (residues 638–656; NTKNHPMLMNLLKDNPAQD) was synthesized by LifeTein and resuspended at 500 μM in buffer containing 20 mM potassium phosphate (pH 7.4), 50 mM potassium chloride, 0.5 mM EDTA, and 5 mM TCEP. PPARγ LBD was prepared at 50 μM in identical buffer. Pio or PioOH (100 μM) was added to PPARγ LBD and TRAP220 peptide (syringe) was titrated into PPARγ LBD (sample cell). Total 20 injections were made per experiment (0.4 μL for the first injection, 2.0 μL for subsequent injections), using a mixing speed of 1200 rpm, a reference power of 5 μcal/s, and a cell temperature of 25 °C. Two runs were performed for each ligand-bound condition. Experiments were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 (Malvern). Data were processed in NITPIC to determine binding stoichiometry and further analyzed by unbiased global fitting of both replicate runs per ligand-bound condition in SEDPHAT followed by export to GUSSI for publication-quality figure preparation. The SEDPHAT fitting model used A + B to AB heteroassociation, and the fit parameters were enthalpy (ΔH) and affinity (Kd).
original_paragraph.Figure 8 caption: Figure 8. PioOH stabilizes co-activator binding to the PPARγ LBD. (A, B) Representative thermograms and normalized plotted data from ITC analysis of TRAP220 binding to Pio- (A) or PioOH- (B) bound PPARγ LBD. (C) Thermodynamic parameters from an unbiased global analysis of two replicate runs per condition.
original_paragraph.Table 6: Table 6. Unbiased Global Fitted ITC Parameters for TRAP220 Peptide Titrated into PPARγ LBDa ligand stoichiometry Kd (nM) ΔG (kcal/mol) ΔH (kcal/mol) ΔS (kcal/(mol K)) Pio 0.783 871 (68.3% CI: 740–1020) −8.27 −9.668 (68.3% CI: −9.8940 to 9.4541) −4.669 PioOH 0.792 708 (68.3% CI: 606–823) −8.39 −10.136 (68.3% CI: −10.3589 to −9.9186) −5.856 a68.3% CI = confidence interval provided by SEDPHAT analyses of two independent ITC runs.
original_paragraph.Results section: To test the thermodynamic basis of this observation, we performed isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) using the unlabeled TRAP220 peptide and the PPARγ LBD bound to 2 molar equiv of either Pio or PioOH (Figure 8A,B). Consistent with the FP assay, the Kd of peptide binding was lower for PioOH-bound PPARγ but did not achieve statistical significance; however, the enthalpy (ΔH) of binding was significantly reduced compared to Pio, suggesting stabilized electrostatic contacts with TRAP220 when bound to PioOH (Table 6 and Figure 8C). Additionally, the entropy (ΔS) of binding was more negative and thus less favorable for PioOH, indicating that the binding dynamics between TRAP220 and PioOH-bound PPARγ LBD are less flexible than for the Pio-bound structure.
